notes.title: Upcoming Project
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
Just wanted to let you know that I'm currently working on a new project.
It's a 2D top-down football game with a strong focus on the story.
Planned release date: [b]2025[/b].
Target platforms: PC (Steam), Google Play, iOS.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049911/415b0cec0d71dce32cf8036889921b997d1f41a5.png[/img]

After that, I’ll have time to return to [b]Football Referee Simulator[/b] again.
